notes.note: The Assistant's /campaigns/callers view is code-only: campaign-callers.spec.ts asserts the Admin, Preacher and Volunteer cases. No browser test proves the Assistant sees their preacher's assignees plus themselves with no status control; the UI gate is staff.role === "Admin" and the route sweep proves the Assistant 200/403, but the rendered scope is unasserted.

campaign-callers.spec.ts pins the ABSENCE of the Contact / Campaigns / Calls made / Reached column headers on the roster, because campaign_progress does not exist yet. Story 1.9's UI layer adds those columns and must replace those four absence assertions with the real counts in the same change, or the suite goes red by design.

The roster's zero-row state is unasserted: an Admin always has staff and a Preacher/Assistant has themselves, so CampaignEmptyState('No callers in your scope yet', 'View campaigns') has no browser coverage without deleting seeded staff.
